human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Replace the current generic five-item Try next list with a maximum of three topic-specific next scans. Suggestions must never display unmeasured counts or imply OpenAIRE evidence before the user actually scans the suggested topic. Depends on: 0001.result-semantics-freeze, 0002.signal-engine-hardening, 0004.golden-demo-contracts.
human_pressure.why_now: The existing generic recommendations are the most obvious LLM-table-of-contents artifact left in the product and weaken the OpenAIRE differentiation.
do_not_misread: This is a hackathon freeze pack: improve credibility and demo reliability without widening the product surface.
Repository-specific file paths and validation commands must be mapped from the actual OpenGap repository before execution.
A measured imbalance is a signal, not proof of a scientific research gap.
red_lines: Do not build a new facet-extraction subsystem during the hackathon freeze.
Do not show counts for a suggestion unless those counts were actually measured.
Do not let LLM-generated suggestions override classifier output.
Do not keep the current five generic template categories as the default.

machine_core.goal: Make next-step exploration clearly distinguish suggested query ideas from measured OpenAIRE evidence, with at most three concise next scans that run through the normal production pipeline when clicked.
red_lines: Do not build a new facet-extraction subsystem during the hackathon freeze.
Do not show counts for a suggestion unless those counts were actually measured.
Do not let LLM-generated suggestions override classifier output.
Do not keep the current five generic template categories as the default.
invariants: A clicked suggestion always runs the normal scan pipeline.
Unscanned suggestions are labeled as suggestions, not evidence.
Suggestion count is capped at three.
Measured facet counts, if present, come from a real scan.
Dependency 0001.result-semantics-freeze must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
Dependency 0002.signal-engine-hardening must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
Dependency 0004.golden-demo-contracts must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
contracts: Deadline-safe mode is Suggested next scans with no fake metrics.
If evidence-backed facets already exist in the codebase, they may display real measured counts.
An LLM, if already used, may suggest only query strings; it may not generate counts, trend, evidence, or finding kind.
failure_semantics: If suggestions cannot be generated safely, omit the section rather than emit generic filler.
If a suggested scan fails, use normal scan error handling.
Unknown suggestion provenance must not be presented as OpenAIRE-derived evidence.

steps.title: Map current suggestion generator
details: Locate the source of narrower/adjacent suggestions and determine whether they are template-, rule-, or LLM-generated.
Keep only the minimum existing mechanism needed for the demo.

steps.title: Rename and cap suggestions
details: Use Suggested next scans unless suggestions already have measured OpenAIRE facet evidence.
Return at most three topic-specific suggestions.

steps.title: Remove implied evidence
details: Do not render counts, trend, or gap labels before a real scan.
Keep narrower/adjacent labels only if they are helpful and truthful.

steps.title: Route clicks through production scan
details: On click, feed the suggestion into the same input/scan/classification/evidence path as a manually entered topic.
Do not create a demo-only shortcut.

acceptance: Suggested next scans are capped at three.
No unscanned suggestion displays a fabricated or implied measured count.
Clicking a suggestion executes the normal scan pipeline.
Generic five-item template output is removed from the default result.
Suggestion generation cannot change finding semantics.

must_check: Suggestions are clearly suggestions unless measured.
No fake counts or evidence appear in next-scan items.
Suggestion click path reaches the production scanner.
The section is omitted rather than filled with generic content when safe suggestions are unavailable.
reject_if: The current generic five-item template list remains unchanged.
An unscanned suggestion shows publication/project/software/dataset counts.
An LLM-generated suggestion directly sets a finding kind.
A new facet subsystem is introduced during the freeze.
The implementation fabricates OpenAIRE counts, records, links, trends, or gap evidence.
The implementation expands the frozen MVP taxonomy beyond funding gap, reuse gap, and no strong structural gap.
The implementation weakens validation or changes validation commands merely to obtain a passing result.
The implementation modifies files outside the repository-mapped minimal scope for this pack.
The implementation introduces unrelated architecture or feature work.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Exact OpenGap test framework and concrete test files are not present in the conversation. Before execution, map package scripts and existing focused/component/e2e tests, then select the narrowest existing targets that protect this pack plus the repository normal full validation command where appropriate.
validation_notes.completion_reason: OpenGap repository paths and exact validation targets were not supplied; repository mapping is required before execution.

completion_constraints: Inspect the actual OpenGap repository before filling file scope or commands.
Map only existing files that directly implement the behavior described by this pack.
New test files may be added only when the existing test layout clearly supports them and they are listed in machine_core.files.create.
Use exact runnable commands from the repository; no shell globs and no invented scripts.
After completion, perform a deterministic schema and scope recheck before coder execution.
